primary.title: Mutual fund growth vs IDCW plans: Top 5 schemes’ returns compared, NAV differences — What investors should know
primary.summary: Growth and IDCW options handle mutual fund earnings differently, affecting payouts, units held, and NAV. Returns across three equity schemes show similarities, but NAV alone cannot determine which option performs better.
